name: MonarchAiScore
title: AiScore
wrapsNative: MonarchScoreRing (androidx.compose.material3.CircularProgressIndicator), MonarchProgress (androidx.compose.material3.LinearProgressIndicator), MonarchBadge, MonarchAiGeneratedBadge and MonarchCollapsible in a androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
summary: A 0 to 100 score produced by a model, as a ring or a bar, with its band, the rationale and the factors that raised or lowered it.
whenToUse: For a model's score of a lead, an account, a ticket or a document, when people need to see why the model scored it that way.
whenNotToUse: For a score with no model behind it, use MonarchScoreRing. For how sure the model is of an answer, use MonarchAiConfidenceMeter.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiScore(value: Double?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchAiScoreVariant = MonarchAiScoreVariant.Ring, size: MonarchAiScoreSize = MonarchAiScoreSize.Md, label: String? = null, bands: List<MonarchAiScoreBand> = MonarchAiScoreBand.defaults(), rationale: String? = null, factors: List<MonarchAiScoreFactor> = emptyList(), showBands: Boolean = true, aiIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, bandIcon: (@Composable (MonarchTone) -> Unit)? = null, expandIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiScoreLabels = MonarchAiScoreLabels())
class MonarchAiScoreBand(minimum: Double, label: String, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Neutral) { companion object { @Composable fun defaults(): List<MonarchAiScoreBand> } }
class MonarchAiScoreFactor(label: String, impact: Double, detail: String? = null)

class MonarchAiScoreLabels(label: String? = null, aiGenerated: String? = null, valueText: ((value: String, max: String) -> String)? = null, unavailable: String? = null, factors: String? = null, impact: ((amount: String, raised: Boolean) -> String)? = null, noImpact: String? = null, bands: String? = null, currentBand: String? = null)

options.name: value
options.description: The score from 0 to 100; values outside are limited. null, or not a number, while there is no score.

options.name: variant
options.description: A ring with the number in its center, or a bar with the number above it.

options.name: size
options.description: The size of the ring: Sm (48dp) or Md (80dp) at the default font size.

options.name: label
options.description: What is scored, such as "Lead score". A heading, and the name of the ring or bar. "Score" when null.

options.name: bands
options.description: Named ranges with a minimum, a label and a MonarchTone: Low (0, danger), Medium (40, warning) and High (70, success) by default, named from strings_aiscore.xml.

options.name: rationale
options.description: Why the model gave this score, in plain words.

options.name: factors
options.description: The inputs that moved the score, each with a label, a signed impact and an optional detail.

options.name: showBands
options.description: Whether the band legend is offered, folded under "How to read this score".

options.name: aiIcon
options.description: An icon for the AI mark. Monarch bundles no icons; the mark is written in any case.

options.name: bandIcon
options.description: An icon for the band badge, given the band's tone. Decorative: the band name is written.

options.name: expandIcon
options.description: The chevron of the band legend header, passed to MonarchCollapsible.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for "Score", "AI score", "72 out of 100", "No score yet", "What affects this score", the spoken impacts, "How to read this score" and "this score" (strings_aiscore.xml).

states.name: scored
states.description: The ring fills to the score in the band's tone, or the bar fills in the band's tone; the band badge shows the band's name in its tone.

states.name: no score
states.description: An empty neutral ring with a dash, or "No score yet" above an empty bar; no band badge.

states.name: factors
states.description: Each factor shows its label, detail, a signed impact ("+18", "−9") and a bar sized against the largest impact, in the success or danger strong color.

states.name: legend
states.description: A folded MonarchCollapsible listing each band with a swatch and its range; the current band is marked "(this score)" in semibold.

appearance: The label is a subheading next to the AI mark in the AI colors. The ring takes the solid color of the band's tone with the number in the tone's strong color; the bar is MonarchProgress in the band's tone (neutral without a band). The band badge is the subtle MonarchBadge of the tone. Factor impacts use the success or danger strong roles, details and ranges the muted text role. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web lists factors and bands in tables; Android shows rows, each read as one element, as iOS does. A band can take any MonarchTone, including Ai and Accent, as the web's ai and accent tones. On the bar variant the bar takes the band's tone, as on the web; the band is also written in the badge and the spoken value, so it never rests on color alone. The web's locale prop is the app's configuration locale. label, rationale and factor text are plain strings, not arbitrary content. The default band names come from resources through MonarchAiScoreBand.defaults(), a composable, so they can be translated; pass your own bands to rename them. The web draws arrow icons by the impacts; Android writes the sign and takes optional icons from the app because Monarch bundles none.
accessibility: The ring is one element named by the label, with the state "72 out of 100" or "No score yet" and the range as progress information; the band badge is read after it.
The bar is one element named by the label, with the state "72 out of 100, High".
The band is always written, so it never depends on color.
Each factor is one element: its label, then "Raised the score by 18" or "Lowered the score by 9", then its detail.
The legend header is the MonarchCollapsible button with a 48dp target; each band row is one element and the current band is marked in words.
The label and the factors heading are headings; text wraps at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: Values above 100 or below 0 are limited; NaN is no score.
A score below the lowest band's minimum takes the lowest band.
Empty bands give a neutral ring, no badge and no legend.
Impact bars are sized against the largest absolute impact, at least 1 point.

examples.title: Ring with rationale and factors
examples.template:
MonarchAiScore(
    value = {{value|double}},
    label = {{label}},
    rationale = {{rationale}},
    factors = listOf(
        MonarchAiScoreFactor({{factors.0.label}}, impact = {{factors.0.impact|double}}, detail = {{factors.0.detail}}),
        MonarchAiScoreFactor({{factors.1.label}}, impact = {{factors.1.impact|double}}),
        MonarchAiScoreFactor({{factors.2.label}}, impact = {{factors.2.impact|double}}),
        MonarchAiScoreFactor({{factors.3.label}}, impact = {{factors.3.impact|double}}, detail = {{factors.3.detail}}),
    ),
    aiIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Bot, contentDescription = null) },
    bandIcon = { tone ->
        MonarchIcon(
            when (tone) {
                MonarchTone.Success -> SampleIcons.Success
                MonarchTone.Warning -> SampleIcons.Warning
                MonarchTone.Danger -> SampleIcons.Error
                else -> SampleIcons.Info
            },
            contentDescription = null,
        )
    },
    expandIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronDown, contentDescription = null) },
)
examples.code:
MonarchAiScore(
    value = 72.0,
    label = "Lead score",
    rationale = "Engaged with recent emails and pricing, but no meeting is booked yet.",
    factors = listOf(
        MonarchAiScoreFactor("Opened the last three emails", impact = 14.0, detail = "All within the past week"),
        MonarchAiScoreFactor("Visited the pricing page", impact = 9.0),
        MonarchAiScoreFactor("No meeting booked yet", impact = -11.0),
        MonarchAiScoreFactor("Company size", impact = 0.0, detail = "Within the usual range"),
    ),
    aiIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Bot, contentDescription = null) },
    bandIcon = { tone ->
        MonarchIcon(
            when (tone) {
                MonarchTone.Success -> SampleIcons.Success
                MonarchTone.Warning -> SampleIcons.Warning
                MonarchTone.Danger -> SampleIcons.Error
                else -> SampleIcons.Info
            },
            contentDescription = null,
        )
    },
    expandIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronDown, contentDescription = null) },
)

examples.title: A bar with custom bands
examples.code:
MonarchAiScore(
    value = 34.0,
    variant = MonarchAiScoreVariant.Bar,
    label = "Churn risk",
    bands = listOf(
        MonarchAiScoreBand(0.0, "Safe", MonarchTone.Success),
        MonarchAiScoreBand(50.0, "At risk", MonarchTone.Danger),
    ),
)
